sentences.show: On this day in 1940, two planes collided in mid-air, and landed as one.
They were Avro Ansons of an Australian flying school.
Two trainee crews, on a cross-country exercise over New South Wales.
Over the town of Brocklesby, they made a banking turn.
The upper pilot, Leonard Fuller, lost sight of the plane beneath him.
The top plane's engines were dead. The bottom plane's still roared at full power.
Fuller stayed, and found he could still steer the pair with ailerons and flaps.
He picked a paddock, and made a belly landing.
And punished, for talking to the newspapers.
Every day has a story like this.
